name: Independent Replication (Metric Contract v2.1)

dataset.independence: new seeds not used in DEV/Conf/TEST v3.1; fresh hidden product truths; no market instance shared with any prior split

global_best_static_selection: re-selected on NEW Generation DEV (v2.1 seeds); not carried over from the invalidated run

primary_questions.A: Fixed/MissingEvidence/Uncertainty/ContextualHybrid differ in task capability or cost efficiency?
primary_questions.B: AdaptiveVOI has real quality/cost advantage, or systematic early-stop / unsupported GO?
primary_questions.C: Under Metric v2.1, what are valid-completion / risk / task-loss differences?
primary_questions.D: OOD degradation: research strategy, evidence availability, or decision rule?

statistics.bootstrap: stratified by mechanism family, 2000 iterations, 95% CI

failure_handling.runtime_error: save full log; one retry; no selective reruns
failure_handling.execution_correctness_error: STOP confirmatory run; save results; mark BLOCKED
failure_handling.unresolved_reachability: reported separately; never forced into GO or abstain

prohibited: using test results to adjust metrics
renaming v2 results as this independent run
